The wrist method in scripts/calibrate_yam_wrist.py adapts the silhouette-calibration idea and YAM camera prior from Stanford-TML/cloak, MIT license, commit 174aa4e8eeec2141e7b5e02978dba9b1c9068bbf. The retained LICENSE applies to the upstream work. No DROID extrinsics are used as ABC calibration results.
